# RealESALetter.com

> > Get FHA-compliant emotional support animal letters from licensed therapists in all 50 states within 24 hours, with no pet rent or deposit fees.

RealESALetter.com provides legitimate ESA and psychiatric service dog letters from licensed mental health professionals. The platform serves all 50 states with transparent pricing, fast online evaluations, and comprehensive legal guidance on housing rights, travel policies, and state-specific ESA laws.
